title: How Hyper-Datafication Impacts the Sustainability Costs in Frontier AI

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting language metadata from approximately 550,000 datasets on the Hugging Face Hub and comparing the volume of datasets available in different languages against their respective global speaker populations and Common Crawl web presence.

Analyzing the spatial concentration of data center infrastructure, electricity demand, and broadband traffic to contrast the dominance of the Global North (primarily the US) with the lack of infrastructure in the Global South, despite high user bases and data worker populations in those regions.

Administering a structured questionnaire to 134 data workers in Kenya and disaggregating the results by gender to evaluate disparities in working hours, salaries, years of experience, and rates of exposure to graphic content.
